configuration_notes: One global hybrid recipe; separate from pure BCAP and pure R1/R2.
No automatic preset/selection change, calibration/default adoption or historical pass transfer.
Prior location policy learned, VICReg weight0 and prior L2 zero; initial distributions/capacity/sampling task-owned.
overview: Explicit hybrid: original BCAP cap plus weak zero-centered real/fake squared-slope damping, with direction-blend DualNorm. Separate formulation; no transfer of pure BCAP qualification. Fixed gamma .05 is tested in one ordinary seed-0 comparison through Tier2; scientific calibration remains provisional.
pseudocode: Compute the existing critic loss plus BCAP cap penalty and gamma/2 times real/fake squared input slopes; backpropagate D.
Apply the selected optimizer rule to D.
Compute the existing G/E/prior loss through the updated critic, retaining task auxiliary terms.
Record actual G-sampled prior rows when the selected optimizer consumes a row mask.
Apply the selected optimizer rule to G/E/prior.
Apply the existing schedule multiplier and score with the frozen task sampling/evaluation law.

Selected rule: For matrix weights, use momentum m=mu*m+g and the polar update sqrt(max(1, fan_out/fan_in))*polar(m). Normalize bias/vector momentum per tensor. Skip matrix gradients below epsilon. Sampled prior rows receive independent normalized-gradient steps with no momentum; unsampled rows do not move. No Adam components.

references.title: Which Training Methods for GANs do actually Converge?
references.component: Zero-centered critic gradient regularization; local convergence assumptions do not certify normalized BCAP.

symbols: G is the generator, E an encoder when present, D the critic, P the task-declared prior, g the loss gradient, m a momentum buffer, mu its coefficient, eta_P the player step size and epsilon the numerical floor. G and E share one player for global normalization. All updates descend their existing public losses.

training_details.averaging: Current BCAP EMA decay 0 and live serving/scoring; this focused study does not substitute the pasted historical EMA/cosine example recipe.
training_details.critic_penalty: BCAP coeff1 cap1 interval1 plus gamma/2 times real and fake squared input slopes; gamma .05. Both contributions use the same lazy schedule.
training_details.damping_and_guards: Existing BCAP disables A2, direct-particle gain and critic spike guard; no replacement intervention is introduced.
training_details.gradient_clipping: No added parameter-gradient clipping. Normalization defines the optimizer step; the existing BCAP term remains a loss penalty on critic input gradients.
training_details.loss: Non-saturating logistic; joint hosts retain their explicit generator/encoder objectives and task auxiliary terms.
training_details.noise: Zero additive training input/output noise. Task-declared prior sampling, named streams and data batches remain unchanged.
training_details.optimizer: Zero-momentum DualNorm, network smoothing .001, explicit prior smoothing .001, per-offset convolution, native SVD, generator-side direction protection.
